scope: Exposed tuning case; post-score model-free diagnostic. This does not alter scores or establish a quality or cost win.
finding: With invalid octal byte and non-EOF read error returned together, revised Develop returns ErrMalformedTree and loses sentinel identity; base, merge, prior Develop and stock preserve the sentinel. This is a change to observed go-git error identity, not a universal I/O error-precedence rule. Incidence in production is unknown.

origin.method: The existing test embeds EncodedObject and supplies io.MultiReader(valid prefix, iotest.ErrReader(sentinel)); this witness adds invalid prefix 8 and ordinary malformed and successful controls.

contracts.relevance: Before a delimiter, ReadSlice can return buffered data and the underlying error together.
Direct Reader clients should process n > 0 bytes before considering err; this does not prescribe Tree.Decode error identity.

source_verification.method: Independently archive each pinned Git commit; for participants apply each sealed patch to a clean base outside the parent Git worktree. Compare every file content SHA-256, symlink target and executable bits to the actual replay copies; exclude only .git and the added witness.go. All five have 756 entries and zero differences. Manifest digest is SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON mapping paths to [file, content SHA-256, octal executable bits] or [link, target].
source_verification.participant_patches: Stock and revised patches are in adjacent diagnostic-artifacts.json; prior patch is embedded below.

execution.dependencies: existing locked go module cache, mounted read-only
execution.replay: For each reconstructed tree, place witness.go in its root and run go run witness.go using the pinned image and offline dependency cache. The local runner uses one container per tree with --cpuset-cpus 4,5 and GOPROXY=off.

control_notes: All five preserve sentinel for empty, 100 and 1000 zeros. Base returns bufio.ErrBufferFull for 9000 zeros before the sentinel, while the other four reach it. All five return ErrMalformedTree for terminated invalid octal, and all decode the normal valid entry. Direct ReadSlice instrumentation prints bytes="8" with sentinel=true for each run.
